C_to_overkt_stand

C_to_overkt_stand.Rd

This functions converts to celcius to inverse Boltzmann temperature (1/kT) from a set standard, e.g., 15 C

Usage

C_to_overkt_stand(a = NULL, mu = 15)

Arguments

a

This is the temperature in celcius

mu

This is the standardization temperature in celcius
